name: FLEET
summary: Your OpenRig machines at a glance: which accounts have room, which machines report, and what your rigs are doing.

surface.hint: accounts, machines and rigs at a glance

_note: Read only, and it needs no other app. It shows what OpenRig's own daemons report and says when something is not reported. It never asks for a sign-in, reads a token or spends an account's allowance.
